verdict.rationale: Angular Signals provide state independent of the DOM (angular-docs-1) and community evidence notes Angular's dependency injection and testing tools (Karma/Protractor) make testing easy (angular-comm-9), implying logic can be tested in isolation. However, there is no direct evidence or docs excerpt describing unit testing signals/services without rendering components, TestBed usage, or DOM-free testing patterns. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of TestBed/service-only unit tests, examples of testing signals without component rendering, independent corroboration of DOM-free testing workflow.
